summary: The three most important visible problems are: (1) skirt/body penetration at the hips and raised thighs, clearest in cross_legged, high_kick, lie_back_elbows, and the seated portion of sit_stand; (2) a conspicuous change in the lifted leg between run frames 8 and 9, visible in both views and suggesting a knee/foot motion discontinuity; and (3) loss of separation between the bulky sleeves across the chest in hug_self. The first two warrant correction before use; the sleeve overlap is smaller and less certain at this resolution. Most other poses preserve believable body proportions and joint volume. These ratings describe the supplied images: absent cloth/hair physics explains unsupported skirt shapes and limited draping, but does not eliminate visible body penetration. Sparse contact-sheet samples cannot establish smoothness between unshown frames, and cropped hands or feet are not treated as deformation defects.

items.name: sit_chair
items.location: Upper thighs and front of skirt, especially the 3/4 view
items.issue: The seated thighs emerge through the front skirt surface above its hem, producing clear cloth/body penetration even allowing for the absence of simulated seat draping.

items.name: seiza
items.location: Folded legs beneath the front skirt and petticoat
items.issue: The skirt and petticoat remain flared around the folded legs with small ambiguous intersections at the knees, although much of the unsupported cloth shape is expected without physics.

items.name: kneel_one
items.location: Raised thigh at the front of the skirt
items.issue: The raised thigh visibly breaks through the skirt panel well above the hem instead of being covered or clearing the skirt opening.

items.name: cross_legged
items.location: Lap, crossed thighs, and shoes against the front of the dress
items.issue: The crossed legs and shoes cut across the intact front skirt and hanging waist ribbons, making the lap read as intersecting layers rather than cloth surrounding the legs.

items.name: deep_lunge
items.location: Forward upper thigh and front skirt panel
items.issue: The forward thigh emerges through the skirt surface above the hem, with a clear skin-to-cloth intersection in both views that missing cloth physics explains but does not conceal.

items.name: run_l
items.location: Raised thigh beneath the lifted skirt
items.issue: The raised thigh crowds the skirt and petticoat opening with a small local intersection, while the broad skirt lift is consistent with the driven chains used without physics.

items.name: run_r
items.location: Raised thigh and adjacent skirt hem
items.issue: The lifted thigh meets the skirt edge abruptly with slight apparent penetration, although the leg itself retains a plausible bend and volume.

items.name: jump_tuck
items.location: Knees against the underside of the skirt and petticoat
items.issue: The tucked knees press into the broad, nearly horizontal skirt opening with small apparent cloth intersections, but there is no clearly collapsed or reversed joint.

items.name: high_kick
items.location: Raised leg at the hip and front of the dress
items.issue: The raised leg passes directly through the front skirt panel, leaving a conspicuous isolated shoe-and-skin shape in front view and a thigh emerging through cloth in the 3/4 view.

items.name: arms_crossed
items.location: Overlapping sleeves across the lower chest
items.issue: The bulky sleeves crowd together into a flattened central overlap with little visible compression or separation, suggesting a small sleeve-to-sleeve intersection.

items.name: hug_self
items.location: Sleeves across the chest and beneath the hands
items.issue: The sleeves merge into a crowded band across the chest with an indistinct overlap boundary, suggesting local cloth interpenetration rather than a clear body-joint failure.

items.name: lie_back_elbows
items.location: Hips and upper thighs through the front skirt
items.issue: Both legs emerge through the intact front skirt above its hem, clearly visible in the 3/4 view, while the skirt retains a standing-like shell instead of clearing the reclined thighs.

items.name: dance_heart
items.location: Hands and wrists above the forehead
items.issue: The hands and cuffs crowd together above the forehead with a slightly tangled contact silhouette, though this sheet does not establish a major wrist collapse.

items.name: run
items.location: Lifted knee, lower leg, and foot, clearest in the 3/4 view
items.issue: The lifted leg changes from a high bent-knee pose to a substantially lower, straighter pose in one frame while the torso barely changes, indicating a conspicuous knee/foot motion discontinuity rather than demonstrated mesh tearing.

items.name: sit_stand
items.location: Upper thighs through the front skirt during the seated phase
items.issue: The seated thighs visibly pass through the front skirt at frames 32–54 before becoming more covered by frame 65, a clear cloth/body intersection despite the expected lack of simulated draping.

items.name: idol_dance
items.location: Raised thigh and skirt opening during the stepping section
items.issue: The raised thigh crowds and slightly intersects the skirt opening during the stepping poses, while the sampled frames do not show a comparably clear joint collapse or one-frame pop.
